79050.u:
From the verb быть (“to be”), via the old passive participle sense “what is being / has been”. Mostly found in philosophical, literary, or archaic texts, not used in modern everyday Russian.

Typical contexts:
 * бути́мые страда́ния — sufferings that are endured
 * бути́мый о́пыт — lived / experienced experience

Modern equivalents (much more common): пережи́тый (experienced), испытанный (undergone), перенесённый (endured)
